name: Shoulder Stretch
description: Stretches the back of the shoulder: bring one arm across your body and hold it with the other arm, above or below the elbow.

source.title: Mayo Clinic: A guide to basic stretches

cues: Hold above or below the elbow, not on the joint.
Keep your shoulders down and relaxed.
Helpful if you play golf, tennis or other throwing or overhead sports.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Arm across
keyframes.cue: Bring your left arm across your body and hold it with your right arm.
